messages:
raj.patel: Heads-up — I'm planning a console RBAC change tomorrow to restrict KMS operations to admin only. Details below, need sec + PM sign-off.

maria: quick q — is this just UI hide or backend enforcement?

raj.patel: backend enforcement. moving permission 'kms.manage_keys' → admin. UI will also hide buttons for non-admins. See diff:
```
- roles.editor.permissions: ["project.read", "deploy", "kms.manage_keys"]
+ roles.editor.permissions: ["project.read", "deploy"]
roles.admin.permissions: ["project.read","deploy","kms.manage_keys","project.settings"]
```

taylor: won't that break some customers who rely on editor rotating keys via console? we have 4 customers using editor->rotate flow in the last 30d.

raj.patel: yes — migration plan: feature-flag rollout + 7-day grace where editors see a warning + a "request access" flow that auto-creates an approval ticket when editors hit rotate.

olivia: can we capture audit logs for any prior editor key rotates and backfill? need security telemetry for compliance.

raj.patel: run this quick query: 
```
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="redwood_console" AND protoPayload.methodName="RotateKey" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:*' --limit 1000
```

sre-bot: Incident-1234 referenced — last month a UI leak exposed key meta to viewers. Attach link: https://alerts.internal/INC-1234

maria: about that leak — severity triage: was key material exposed or just key IDs?

prod-qa: verified: only key IDs and last-4 digits, no secret. still PII-ish for audit.

maria: ok mark as P2. recommend short PR: remove last-4 display for viewers immediately.

taylor: on tests — need to update e2e: tests/console/kms_spec.ts -> adjust expected button visibility. I'll open PR after approval.

raj.patel: approval requested from @olivia and @security-team. Also need to update policy docs + changelog for Dedicated customers.

olivia: approve from sec side pending audit retention proof. we need 90-day immutable logs for key ops. Can ops confirm?

sre-bot: @eng-sre ping — are we meeting 90d retention for the console audit logs?

eng-sre: yes — logs are shipped to GCS with retention 365d, immutability enabled for prod projects.

raj.patel: cool. final checklist:
- [x] backend permission enforcement
- [ ] UI hide + request-access flow
- [ ] e2e + regression tests
- [ ] customer communications
- [ ] update docs + release notes

maria: I'll draft the customer note.
taylor: will coordinate test PR.
olivia: security will review the audit proof today.

raj.patel: thanks — if no blockers I'll schedule deploy 09:00 UTC tomorrow and roll feature-flag for 10% then 100% in 24h.

olivia: :thumbsup:
